limits: Counts describe named scenarios, not every assertion, overload, or possible execution.
The cases include clearly labeled comparison variants such as explicit defaults and inclusive takeWhile.
Worked-trace state columns are explanatory models; runtime checks observe public behavior rather than private implementation state.
No exhaustive scheduler, reentrancy, liveness, or formal-equivalence claim is made.
This manifest records executed review evidence; it is not an installed automated test suite.
find/findIndex at-most-one cardinality is explicitly scoped to non-reentrant delivery; two checks record repeated results possible before completion during synchronous feedback.
